peoples_entry.name: Fellgangs (West Rift & Blakhed)
peoples_entry.note: Daylight surface pit-clans of Blakhed, Chimes Gorge, West Rift Rim, Winterings Vardo Travellers, Wildcat, and deep-karst Kradz: sheared Ancient highway-sign pauldrons & bucklers, conveyor-belt tyre brigandines, greased slate-wool maud plaids, A-frame gorge kreels, painted vardo oilcloth coats, and pale cave-chitin karst harnesses.
